title: Item:Arcane Signet Ring
wikitext:
[[File:Arcane Signet Ring.png|thumb|300px|right|]]
'''Arcane Signet Ring''' is an in-quest item in [[the Vault of Night]] raid, absolutely required for the completion of the raid.

'''Description''': Key: Arcane Signet Ring. This exquisite arcane signet ring bears the sigil of [[House Kundarak]].

'''Binding''': {{Bind|no|drops=both}}

'''In-quest use''':
* To gain the ring, kill [[Otto Knucklebones]] in the western wing of the raid. Once Otto is dead, the ring will appear on the floor as a small purple [[Treasure Bag]]. Don't pick it up unless you are the person designated by the group to do it.
* Use the ring to open the force fields with color wheels: North wing, left path. Walking up to the force fields while the ring is in the inventory will make them disappear.
* If you picked it up but don't intend to go to the left path of the north wing, [[trade]] it to someone who will. The ring does not bind to your character.
* The ring drops on death so be sure you pick it up after dying.
